'''Atrakenites''' were the [[Human/Legends|Human]] population native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Atraken/Legends|Atraken]], who later moved to the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Trilos]] following the [[Battle of Atraken]].
